abort.description: Stop after N consecutive skipped downloads

cbz.description: Store downloaded files in CBZ archive

chapter_range.description: Chapter/index range for manga and delegated content

cookies.description: Path to file containing additional cookies

cookies_from_browser.description: Browser to load cookies from, optionally with DOMAIN, KEYRING, PROFILE, CONTAINER

destination.description: Target location for file downloads (global destination directory)

directory.description: Exact location for file downloads (overrides destination per extraction)

download_archive.description: Path to archive file for tracking already downloaded/skipped files

error_file.description: File to record input URLs that returned an error

exec.description: Command to execute per downloaded file (supports {} placeholders)

exec_after.description: Command to execute after all downloads complete

extra_options.description: Arbitrary key-value settings for advanced or extractor-specific options

extractors.description: List of per-extractor configurations with name, username, password, and options fields

filename.description: Filename format string for downloaded files

filter.description: Python expression controlling which files to download

force_ipv4.description: Force all connections to use IPv4

force_ipv6.description: Force all connections to use IPv6

http_timeout.description: Timeout for HTTP connections in seconds

mtime.description: Source metadata field to set file modification time (e.g., 'date')

no_colors.description: Disable ANSI color codes in output

no_download.description: Simulate only: do not download any files

no_mtime.description: Do not set file modification times from Last-Modified headers

no_part.description: Disable use of .part files during downloads

no_skip.description: Disable skipping downloads; overwrite existing files

print.description: Print EVENT:FORMAT during download (default event is 'prepare')

print_to_file.description: Append EVENT:FORMAT to file during download

range.description: Index range(s) specifying which files to download (e.g., '5', '8-20')

rename.description: Rename previously downloaded files from FORMAT to current format

rename_to.description: Rename previously downloaded files from current format to FORMAT

retries.description: Maximum number of retries for failed HTTP requests (-1 for infinite)

sleep.description: Seconds to wait before each download (e.g., '2.0-3.5' or '1.5')

sleep_extractor.description: Seconds to wait before starting extraction for an input URL

sleep_request.description: Seconds to wait between HTTP requests during extraction

source_address.description: Client-side IP address to bind to

terminate.description: Stop extractor and parent runs after N consecutive skipped downloads

user_agent.description: User-Agent header to use in HTTP requests

write_log.description: Write logging output to this file

write_metadata.description: Write metadata to separate JSON files

write_tags.description: Write image tags to separate text files

zip.description: Store downloaded files in ZIP archive
